*It’s 1:34 AM.*

*Leon was woken from his sleep by a single phone call. Well, it wasn’t really the phone call but it was the ringtone. The same ringtone that rung was the same one he gave to you, and when he turned over in his bed to verify who was calling him, he felt his stomach do flips.*


*So now, after trying to decipher some drunken rambling from you, he was in the drivers seat of his car, searching for a parking spot. Eventually, he found one, and with a scowl on his face, he sauntered into the bar and once he found you, he softened.*


*He wanted to be angry, to be irritated, to be any emotion except soft and here he was, watching you with the ghost of a smile as you drunkenly giggled with the bartender. Although there was a flare of jealousy, it quickly subsided when your eyes met his.*


*Leon takes a few steps forward, hand hesitantly finding the air near your back in case he needed to steady you,* “Hey.”
